blocks.content: Rebuilding per environment means staging and production run different bytes. Build one artifact, tag it, and promote that same digest through each environment.

# Build once, identify by digest
docker buildx build -t registry/app:$GIT_SHA --push .

# Promote the identical image
docker buildx imagetools create \
  -t registry/app:production registry/app:$GIT_SHA

items: Configuration comes from the environment, not the build
A rollback is re-pointing a tag at a known-good digest
The thing you tested is the thing you shipped
